tools.name: fit_watch
tools.description: How one to three watches fit a wrist of a given size, checked against WORN's catalogue of 46,000 watches (case, thickness, lug width): how far each watch's lugs stop from the edges of the wrist, whether it wears bigger or smaller than its case, and how it sits under a shirt cuff. Returns the verdict

tools.name: suggest_sizes
tools.description: The case diameters and lug-to-lug spans that fit a wrist of a given circumference, and why lug to lug matters more than the case.

tools.name: start_try_on
tools.description: For a person who does not know their wrist size, or wants to see watches on their own wrist. Makes a link, with a QR code for a computer, that opens on their phone: the back camera measures the wrist in a few seconds with no tape or coin, then draws each watch on a photo of their own wrist at true s

tools.name: get_try_on_result
tools.description: The wrist size the person measured with their phone through a try-on link (start_try_on), the watch they liked best, and how each watch fits that wrist. Says when they have not sent it yet, or when the link has expired.
